name: Reclaim Cloud
line: Deploy and manage containerized apps on a prepaid cloud platform.

free.text: 2-week trial, no funds to start; prepaid use after trial

cells.regions: US, Canada, UK and European Union

work.math: Compute is 2 × $0.0039 × 730 = $5.694. Add the unknown public IP cost, plus build, disk, traffic and tax costs (unknown). 100 GB fits 2 GB an hour only if traffic is spread evenly.
8 × $0.0037 × 730 = $21.608 for compute. The 1,024 MiB figure applies only under 128 MiB units. 400 MHz per cloudlet is not a vCPU. IP, build, disk and traffic costs are still unknown.
Compute is $43.216 at the 5–9 rate, or $38.544 only if 16 units pool at the 10–19 rate. Add unknown IP, disk, backup, build and tax costs. Private 10 GB database traffic is free.
